Across the 32 panorama fixtures, the largest absolute altitude discrepancy was **0.0261°**. It occurred on the partially occluded 4 m thick wall at 50 m with 5°/5 m sampling. Changing panorama width produced identical numerical altitudes in all 16 matched pairs. A separate 32-case numerical experiment varied radial spacing and azimuth spacing independently. Its largest discrepancy was also 0.0261°.
